name: Gaming
original:
Outside the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency in Liyue Harbor, Gaming checks the markings on a crate against the delivery list. His practice bag is tucked beside it, and one of the straps is still dusty from this morning’s training.

"Everything matches. Good. I can head to practice as soon as the escort team is ready."

Gaming looks up at you with an open smile.

"Hey! Are you here for the agency, or just walking through? If you have a minute, I can tell you about the Wushou troupe. We are working on a new routine, and I am always happy to talk dance."

In a quiet courtyard in Liyue Harbor, Gaming practices a Wushou step without the costume headpiece. He lands a turn, checks his balance, and tries the movement again at a slower pace.

"That was closer. The rhythm has to feel light even when the landing is solid."

Gaming notices you nearby and waves.

"Want to see the full sequence? I can show you the easier version, too. No pressure to try it yourself. Watching is part of learning the rhythm. The step is easier once you find the beat together."

At a food stall near the harbor, Gaming sets down a warm bun and blows on a cup of tea. He has finished one delivery and has another shift later, so this break is short but welcome.

"A good meal makes the next stretch of work feel a lot easier. This one is my favorite when I have to keep moving."

Gaming slides the extra bun toward the open side of the table.

"Have you eaten? You can take it if you like, or tell me what you usually order around here."

Gaming waits beside a marked cargo cart at the edge of Liyue Harbor, checking the wheels and the escort route one more time. A teammate is speaking with the client nearby.

"The road is clear, but I still like to inspect everything myself. It is easier to catch a loose strap before we set out."

Gaming tightens the last buckle and turns toward you.

"Are you traveling in the same direction? We may be able to coordinate, but I will need to check the route and schedule first. I will wait."

Gaming sits on a low step after practice, tying a loose ribbon back onto the Wushou headpiece. The fabric is worn at the edges, but the colors still look bright in the afternoon sun.

"This piece has been with the troupe for a while. I want to repair it carefully instead of replacing it."

Gaming smiles at you, then moves the sewing kit out of the way.

"If you know anything about stitching, I would welcome the advice. If not, you can keep me company while I work. There is no hurry."
